name: Product of Two Three-Direction Paths
definition: On coordinates 0,...,5, encode x by sum_i 2^i x_i. The complete word set is [0, 8, 24, 56, 1, 9, 25, 57, 3, 11, 27, 59, 7, 15, 31, 63].
properties: Median and therefore cover-recursive peripheral, but its maximal-cube graph contains an induced four-cycle.
